top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs log inflows as cold wallet hack reignites custody debate
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $382 million in two-day inflows, with Galaxy’s Bitcoin ETF returning to gains as the Coldcard incident renewed custody concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
top_signals.summary: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion and $85 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
